home.title: Chromatic • Senior Product Designer • Carl Avidano
home.description: Selected work for Chromatic: accessible component systems, React implementation, visual design, research, and developer collaboration.
home.headline: I design, build, and test accessible interfaces.
home.who: I’m a product designer and front-end developer based in New York. My background spans public services, education, and nonprofit work, including design leadership at NYC OTI and Reingold. I also run Avidano Digital, where I work directly with clients to design and build their websites and digital tools.
home.what: I help teams understand what people need and turn those findings into accessible interfaces. I stay involved through implementation, working with developers and writing code myself. I also create and maintain design systems, giving teams reusable components and clear guidance they can apply across projects.
home.introduction: Hi there. I’m Carl, and I’m eager to apply for the Senior Product Designer role with Chromatic because it brings together my experience in design and front-end development. I’ve spent more than 15 years designing and building digital experiences, with accessibility and design systems now central to my work.
home.projectsIntroduction: I’ve tailored the following case studies to highlight the work and outcomes most relevant to what you’re looking for in your next Senior Product Designer.
